craft_notes: Sthāyin: dwelling asked. Device: em-dash→comma line 1 (straylessness stated softly), end-dash kept line 2 (settling released). Rejected: 'still' as quiet vs motionless — kept as L3 (both true). Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Still, strayless, honeymere, midmost thy ken-sea —
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvavibhramanirmokaniṣkampam amṛtahradam bhavajjñānāmbudher madhyam adhyāsīyāpi dhūrjaṭe

reads_against.argmap: Tremorless, shed of all wandering, nectar-lake.; The middle of your knowledge-ocean — may I dwell upon, O Dhūrjaṭi. → May I dwell in your knowledge-ocean's tremorless middle.
c1_essence: Quiverless sweet mere mid knowing-sea dwelt in.
reads_against.l2: Quiverless, quit of every stray, a mere of sweet — O let me settle in mid-sea of your knowing, Matted One.
